'use strict';
const E=Shade,R=ShadeRender,$=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const make=(tag,attrs={},text)=>{const n=document.createElement(tag);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(attrs)){if(k==='class')n.className=v;else if(k==='style')n.style.cssText=v;else n.setAttribute(k,v);}if(text!==undefined)n.textContent=text;return n;};
let project=E.defaultProject(),ballId=project.balls[0].id,roleId='base',analysisIds=['base','highlight','shadow'],samples=[],sampleIndex=-1,history=[],future=[],markers=[],reference=null,drag=null;
const qaMode=new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('qa');
try{const saved=qaMode?null:localStorage.getItem('shadelab-v1');if(saved)project=E.validateDocument(JSON.parse(saved));ballId=project.balls[0].id;samples=project.samples||[];sampleIndex=samples.length-1;}catch{}
const ball=()=>project.balls.find(b=>b.id===ballId)||project.balls[0];
const role=()=>ball().roles.find(r=>r.id===roleId);
const colors=()=>E.resolve(ball());
const snapshot=()=>JSON.stringify(project);
function remember(){const s=snapshot();if(history.at(-1)!==s)history.push(s);if(history.length>100)history.shift();future=[];}
function status(message,error=false){$('status').textContent=message;$('status').classList.toggle('error',error);}
function persist(){project.samples=samples;if(qaMode)return;try{localStorage.setItem('shadelab-v1',snapshot());}catch{status('Browser storage unavailable. Use Save project to keep your work.');}}
function change(fn,message='Updated',full=true){const before=snapshot();try{fn();E.validateDocument(project);if(before!==snapshot()){history.push(before);if(history.length>100)history.shift();future=[];}render(full);persist();status(message);}catch(error){project=JSON.parse(before);render(true);status(error.message,true);}}
function selectBall(id){ballId=id;roleId='base';analysisIds=['base','highlight','shadow'].filter(id=>id==='base'||ball().roles.some(r=>r.id===id));render(true);}
function selectRole(id){roleId=id;render(true);}
function options(node,items,value){node.replaceChildren(...items.map(([id,name])=>make('option',{value:id},name)));node.value=value;}
const ids=b=>[['base',b.baseName||'Base'],...b.roles.map(r=>[r.id,r.name])];
function syncInput(id,value){if(document.activeElement!==$(id))$(id).value=value;}
function render(full=true){const b=ball(),cs=E.resolve(b);if(!cs[roleId])roleId='base';analysisIds=analysisIds.filter(id=>cs[id]);$('undo').disabled=!history.length;$('redo').disabled=!future.length;if(document.activeElement!==$('project-title'))$('project-title').textContent=project.name||'Untitled studies';syncInput('ball-name',b.name);syncInput('base-name',b.baseName||'Base');$('ball-mode').value=b.mode;syncInput('softness',b.softness);$('soft-value').textContent=b.softness+'%';$('strength').max=Math.max(3,b.strength);syncInput('strength',b.strength);$('strength-value').textContent=b.strength+'×';$('group-move').checked=!!b.groupMove;options($('selected-role'),ids(b),roleId);syncInput('hex',E.toHex(cs[roleId]));$('native-color').value=E.toHex(cs[roleId]);
 if(full){renderSliders();renderRuleEditor();renderAnalysisChecks();}else updateSliders();
 markers=R.drawWheel($('wheel'),b,roleId,analysisIds);renderGallery();renderComparisons();renderRelationships();renderSamples();const fit=R.graph($('graph'),b,analysisIds);$('fit-result').textContent=!fit?'Select at least 2 colors':fit.vertical!==undefined?`S = ${fit.vertical.toFixed(2)} (vertical)`:`L = ${fit.m.toFixed(3)} × S ${fit.b<0?'−':'+'} ${Math.abs(fit.b).toFixed(2)}\nR² = ${fit.r2.toFixed(3)}`;$('use-fit').disabled=!fit||fit.vertical!==undefined||roleId==='base';}
function renderSliders(){const model=$('color-model').value;const fields=E.CHANNELS[model].map(c=>{const row=make('div',{class:'slider-line'});row.append(make('label',{for:'slider-'+c},c));const range=make('input',{id:'slider-'+c,type:'range',min:0,max:E.LIMITS[c],step:1,'aria-label':c+' channel'}),number=make('input',{id:'number-'+c,type:'number',min:0,max:E.LIMITS[c],step:1,'aria-label':c+' value'});range.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{remember();range._start=E.clone(ball());});range.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(!range._start){remember();range._start=E.clone(ball());}const b=ball();Object.assign(b,E.clone(range._start));applyChannel(c,Number(range.value),false);});range.addEventListener('change',()=>{range._start=null;render(true);persist();});number.addEventListener('change',()=>change(()=>setChannel(c,Number(number.value))));row.append(range,number);return row;});$('sliders').replaceChildren(...fields);updateSliders();}
function updateSliders(){const vals=E.values(colors()[roleId]),model=$('color-model').value;for(const c of E.CHANNELS[model]){const range=$('slider-'+c),num=$('number-'+c);if(!range)continue;range.value=Math.round(vals[c]);if(document.activeElement!==num)num.value=Math.round(vals[c]);const lo={...vals,[c]:0},hi={...vals,[c]:E.LIMITS[c]};range.style.background=c==='H'?'linear-gradient(to right,#ff0000,#ffff00,#00ff00,#00ffff,#0000ff,#ff00ff,#ff0000)':`linear-gradient(to right,${E.toHex(E.fromModel(model,lo,vals.H))},${E.toHex(E.fromModel(model,hi,vals.H))})`;}}
function setChannel(c,v){if(!Number.isFinite(v))throw Error('Enter a valid number.');const b=ball(),current=colors()[roleId],vals=E.values(current);vals[c]=E.clamp(Math.round(v),0,E.LIMITS[c]);E.editColor(b,roleId,E.fromModel($('color-model').value,vals,current[0]),!!b.groupMove);}
function applyChannel(c,v,full){try{setChannel(c,v);render(full);persist();}catch(e){status(e.message,true);}}
function renderGallery(){const cards=project.balls.map(b=>{const card=make('article',{class:'ball-card'+(b.id===ballId?' active':''),tabindex:0,'aria-label':b.name});card.addEventListener('click',()=>selectBall(b.id));card.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')selectBall(b.id);});const top=make('div',{class:'ball-top'}),actions=make('div',{class:'ball-actions'});const copy=make('button',{title:'Duplicate ball','aria-label':'Duplicate '+b.name},'⧉'),remove=make('button',{title:'Remove ball','aria-label':'Remove '+b.name},'×');copy.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();change(()=>{const duplicate=E.clone(b);duplicate.id=E.uid();duplicate.name+=' copy';project.balls.push(duplicate);ballId=duplicate.id;roleId='base';},'Ball duplicated');};remove.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();if(project.balls.length===1){status('Keep at least one ball in the project.');return;}change(()=>{project.balls=project.balls.filter(v=>v.id!==b.id);if(ballId===b.id){ballId=project.balls[0].id;roleId='base';}},'Ball removed; Undo restores it');};actions.append(copy,remove);top.append(make('strong',{},b.name),actions);const canvas=make('canvas',{width:400,height:330});R.ballCanvas(canvas,b);const swatches=make('div',{class:'swatches'});for(const[id,hsl]of Object.entries(E.resolve(b))){const sw=make('button',{class:'swatch'+(b.id===ballId&&id===roleId?' selected':''),style:'background:'+E.toHex(hsl),title:E.roleName(b,id)+' · '+E.toHex(hsl),'aria-label':E.roleName(b,id)});sw.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();ballId=b.id;selectRole(id);};swatches.append(sw);}const meta=make('div',{class:'card-meta'});meta.append(make('span',{},b.mode==='cel'?'Cel shading':'Rim + bounce'),make('span',{},b.strength+'×'));card.append(top,canvas,swatches,meta);return card;});$('gallery').replaceChildren(...cards);}
function renderComparisons(){$('compare-name').textContent=ball().name;syncInput('comparison-values',(project.comparisons||[.5,1,2,3]).join(', '));const children=[];for(const t of project.comparisons||[.5,1,2,3]){const div=make('div',{class:'comparison-card'}),canvas=make('canvas',{width:240,height:210});try{R.ballCanvas(canvas,ball(),t);div.append(canvas,make('span',{},t+'× strength'));}catch(e){div.append(make('p',{class:'hint'},t+'×: '+e.message));}children.push(div);}$('comparison-gallery').replaceChildren(...children);}
function renderRelationships(){const b=ball(),cs=colors();$('relationship-list').replaceChildren(...ids(b).map(([id,name])=>{const r=b.roles.find(r=>r.id===id),model=r?.model||'HSL',vals=E.values(cs[id]);const bt=make('button',{class:'relationship'+(id===roleId?' active':'')}),text=make('span',{class:'relation-text'}),source=id==='base'?'Starting color · HSL':`← ${E.roleName(b,r.source)} · ${model}`;text.append(make('span',{},name),make('small',{},source));bt.append(make('span',{class:'color-dot',style:'background:'+E.toHex(cs[id])}),text,make('span',{class:'relation-values'},E.CHANNELS[model].map(c=>Math.round(vals[c])).join(' / ')));bt.onclick=()=>selectRole(id);return bt;}));}
function renderRuleEditor(){const r=role();$('base-note').hidden=!!r;$('rule-editor').hidden=!r;if(!r)return;syncInput('role-name',r.name);options($('rule-source'),ids(ball()).filter(([id])=>id!==r.id),r.source);$('rule-model').value=r.model;const fields=E.CHANNELS[r.model].map(c=>{const div=make('label',{class:'formula-line'}),input=make('input',{'data-channel':c,'aria-label':c+' formula',spellcheck:'false'});input.value=r.expressions[c];div.append(make('span',{},c),input);return div;});$('expression-fields').replaceChildren(...fields);$('sl-link-label').hidden=r.model!=='HSL';const simple=E.simpleAmounts(r);$('amount-type').value=simple.kind||'points';$('simple-builder').querySelector('p').textContent=simple.kind?'Use signed numbers: −10 subtracts, +10 adds. Amounts scale with strength t.':'Custom formulas are active. Applying amounts replaces them.';if(r.model==='HSL')$('sl-link').checked=simple.amounts.S===simple.amounts.L;const controls=E.CHANNELS[r.model].map(c=>{const label=make('label',{class:'field'},c+' amount');const input=make('input',{type:'number',step:'any','data-amount':c,'aria-label':c+' amount'});input.value=simple.amounts[c];input.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(c==='S'&&$('sl-link').checked){const l=document.querySelector('[data-amount="L"]');if(l)l.value=input.value;}});label.append(input);return label;});$('amount-controls').replaceChildren(...controls);}
function renderAnalysisChecks(){$('analysis-roles').replaceChildren(...ids(ball()).map(([id,name])=>{const label=make('label',{class:'check'}),check=make('input',{type:'checkbox'});check.checked=analysisIds.includes(id);check.onchange=()=>{analysisIds=check.checked?[...analysisIds,id]:analysisIds.filter(v=>v!==id);render(false);};label.append(check,make('span',{},name));return label;}));}
function renderSamples(){$('samples').replaceChildren(...samples.map((s,i)=>{const b=make('button',{class:'sample'+(sampleIndex===i?' active':''),style:'background:'+E.toHex(s),title:E.toHex(s),'aria-label':'Apply sample '+(i+1)+' '+E.toHex(s)});b.onclick=()=>{sampleIndex=i;change(()=>E.editColor(ball(),roleId,s,!!ball().groupMove),'Sample applied to '+E.roleName(ball(),roleId));};return b;}));$('sample-study').disabled=sampleIndex<0;$('sample-region').disabled=sampleIndex<0;}
function addSample(hsl,apply=true){samples.push(hsl);sampleIndex=samples.length-1;if(apply)change(()=>E.editColor(ball(),roleId,hsl,!!ball().groupMove),'Screen color sampled. Pick again to collect another.');else{renderSamples();persist();}}
const offsetExpression=(c,d,t)=>t?`${c} + (${Number((d/t).toPrecision(10))}) * t`:`${c} + (${Number(d.toPrecision(10))})`;
function newRegion(hsl){const b=ball(),id='color_'+E.uid();const source=E.values(b.base),target=E.values(hsl||colors()[roleId]);b.roles.push({id,name:'Color '+(b.roles.length+1),source:'base',model:'HSL',expressions:Object.fromEntries([...'HSL'].map(c=>[c,offsetExpression(c,target[c]-source[c],b.strength)]))});roleId=id;}
$('add-ball').onclick=()=>change(()=>{const b=E.defaultBall('Study '+(project.balls.length+1),[Math.floor(Math.random()*360),65,50]);project.balls.push(b);ballId=b.id;roleId='base';},'New ball added');
$('ball-name').onchange=()=>change(()=>ball().name=$('ball-name').value.trim()||'Untitled ball');
$('base-name').onchange=()=>change(()=>ball().baseName=$('base-name').value.trim()||'Base');
$('project-title').onblur=()=>change(()=>project.name=$('project-title').textContent.trim()||'Untitled studies');
$('selected-role').onchange=()=>selectRole($('selected-role').value);
$('color-model').onchange=()=>renderSliders();
$('show-wheel').onclick=()=>{$('wheel-section').hidden=false;$('show-wheel').classList.add('active');$('show-sliders').classList.remove('active');};
$('show-sliders').onclick=()=>{$('wheel-section').hidden=true;$('show-wheel').classList.remove('active');$('show-sliders').classList.add('active');};
$('hex').onchange=()=>change(()=>E.editColor(ball(),roleId,E.hexHsl($('hex').value),!!ball().groupMove));
$('native-color').onchange=()=>change(()=>E.editColor(ball(),roleId,E.hexHsl($('native-color').value),!!ball().groupMove));
$('group-move').onchange=()=>{const on=$('group-move').checked;change(()=>{if(on)E.lockOffsets(ball());ball().groupMove=on;},on?'Current HSL spacing captured. Drag any marker to move the group.':'Base-driven formula editing restored');};
for(const[id,key]of [['softness','softness'],['strength','strength']]){const input=$(id);input.onpointerdown=remember;input.onkeydown=e=>{if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','Home','End'].includes(e.key))remember();};input.oninput=()=>{const old=ball()[key];try{ball()[key]=Number(input.value);E.resolve(ball());render(false);persist();}catch(e){ball()[key]=old;input.value=old;render(false);status(e.message,true);}};input.onchange=()=>render(true);}
$('ball-mode').onchange=()=>change(()=>ball().mode=$('ball-mode').value);
$('role-name').onchange=()=>change(()=>role().name=$('role-name').value.trim()||'Color');
$('add-role').onclick=()=>change(()=>newRegion(), 'Region added to palette and analysis');
$('delete-role').onclick=()=>change(()=>{if(ball().roles.some(r=>r.source===roleId))throw Error('Other colors use this region. Change their source before removing it.');ball().roles=ball().roles.filter(r=>r.id!==roleId);roleId='base';},'Region removed; Undo restores it');
$('rule-source').onchange=()=>change(()=>{role().source=$('rule-source').value;ball().groupMove=false;});
$('rule-model').onchange=()=>{const model=$('rule-model').value;change(()=>{const r=role(),cs=colors(),target=E.values(cs[roleId]),source=E.values(cs[r.source]);r.model=model;r.expressions=Object.fromEntries(E.CHANNELS[model].map(c=>[c,offsetExpression(c,target[c]-source[c],ball().strength)]));ball().groupMove=false;});};
$('apply-formulas').onclick=()=>{const trial=E.clone(ball()),r=trial.roles.find(r=>r.id===roleId);for(const field of $('expression-fields').querySelectorAll('input'))r.expressions[field.dataset.channel]=field.value.trim();trial.groupMove=false;try{E.resolve(trial);change(()=>Object.assign(ball(),trial),'Formulas applied');}catch(e){status(e.message,true);}};
$('apply-amounts').onclick=()=>change(()=>{const r=role(),percent=$('amount-type').value==='percent';let amounts=Object.fromEntries([...$('amount-controls').querySelectorAll('input')].map(n=>[n.dataset.amount,Number(n.value)]));if(r.model==='HSL'&&$('sl-link').checked)amounts.L=amounts.S;for(const c of E.CHANNELS[r.model]){if(!Number.isFinite(amounts[c]))throw Error('Enter numeric amounts.');r.expressions[c]=percent?`${c} * (1 + (${amounts[c]}) / 100 * t)`:`${c} + (${amounts[c]}) * t`;}ball().groupMove=false;},'Linked amounts applied');
$('update-comparisons').onclick=()=>change(()=>{const ts=$('comparison-values').value.split(',').map(s=>Number(s.trim()));if(!ts.length||ts.some(t=>!Number.isFinite(t)||t<0||t>10))throw Error('Use comma-separated strengths between 0 and 10.');project.comparisons=ts;},'Comparison strengths updated');
$('use-fit').onclick=()=>change(()=>{const cs=colors(),fit=E.fitLine(analysisIds.map(id=>[cs[id][1],cs[id][2]]));if(!fit||fit.vertical!==undefined||!role())throw Error('Select a derived region and at least two colors with different saturation.');const r=role();if(r.model!=='HSL')throw Error('Change this region’s formula model to HSL first.');r.expressions.L=`(${Number(fit.m.toPrecision(8))}) * (${r.expressions.S}) + (${Number(fit.b.toPrecision(8))})`;ball().groupMove=false;},'Fitted line saved as the selected region’s L rule');
function undo(redo=false){const from=redo?future:history,to=redo?history:future;if(!from.length)return;to.push(snapshot());project=JSON.parse(from.pop());samples=project.samples||[];sampleIndex=samples.length-1;if(!project.balls.some(b=>b.id===ballId))ballId=project.balls[0].id;render(true);persist();status(redo?'Redone':'Undone');}
$('undo').onclick=()=>undo();$('redo').onclick=()=>undo(true);document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='z'&&!['INPUT','TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)&&!document.activeElement.isContentEditable){e.preventDefault();undo(e.shiftKey);}});
const safeName=s=>(s||'shade-lab').replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]/g,'_').slice(0,120);
function download(blob,name){const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=make('a',{href:url,download:name});a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),10000);}
function jsonDownload(data,name){download(new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),safeName(name)+'.json');status('Saved '+name+'.json');}
$('save-project').onclick=()=>jsonDownload(project,project.name);
$('save-preset').onclick=()=>{const name=$('preset-name').value.trim()||'My shading recipe';jsonDownload(E.preset(ball(),name),name);};
$('open-json').onclick=()=>$('json-file').click();$('json-file').onchange=async()=>{const file=$('json-file').files[0];if(!file)return;try{const data=E.validateDocument(JSON.parse(await file.text()));change(()=>{if(data.schema==='shadelab.project'){project=data;ballId=project.balls[0].id;roleId='base';samples=project.samples||[];sampleIndex=samples.length-1;}else{E.applyPreset(ball(),data);ball().groupMove=false;roleId='base';$('preset-name').value=data.name||'Imported recipe';}},'Opened '+file.name);}catch(e){status('Could not open JSON: '+e.message,true);}finally{$('json-file').value='';}};
$('eyedropper').onclick=async()=>{if(!window.EyeDropper){status('Screen picking needs desktop Edge or Chrome. You can also paste/load a screenshot here.',true);return;}try{const result=await new EyeDropper().open();addSample(E.hexHsl(result.sRGBHex));}catch(e){if(e.name!=='AbortError')status('Screen picker: '+e.message,true);}};
if(!window.EyeDropper)$('pick-hint').textContent='Screen eyedropper requires desktop Edge or Chrome. Image sampling works in this browser.';
$('clear-samples').onclick=()=>{samples=[];sampleIndex=-1;renderSamples();persist();};
$('sample-study').onclick=()=>change(()=>{const b=E.defaultBall('Sample study '+(project.balls.length+1),samples[sampleIndex]);project.balls.push(b);ballId=b.id;roleId='base';},'New study from screen sample');
$('sample-region').onclick=()=>change(()=>newRegion(samples[sampleIndex]),'Sample added as a region');
$('wheel').onpointerdown=e=>{const rect=$('wheel').getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width*320,y=(e.clientY-rect.top)/rect.height*320;const nearest=markers.map(m=>({...m,d:Math.hypot(m.x-x,m.y-y)})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d)[0];let kind;if(nearest&&nearest.d<11){roleId=nearest.id;kind=nearest.kind;render(true);}else{const radius=Math.hypot(x-160,y-160);if(radius>127&&radius<158)kind='hue';else{const hsl=E.triangleColor(x,y,0);const edge=99+149*(1-Math.abs(2*hsl[2]/100-1));if(x<97||x>edge+3||y<60||y>260)return;kind='triangle';}}remember();drag={kind,start:E.clone(ball())};$('wheel').setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);document.body.classList.add('dragging');moveWheel(e);};
function moveWheel(e){if(!drag)return;const rect=$('wheel').getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width*320,y=(e.clientY-rect.top)/rect.height*320,b=ball();Object.assign(b,E.clone(drag.start));const current=colors()[roleId],next=drag.kind==='hue'?[E.wrap(Math.atan2(y-160,x-160)*180/Math.PI+90),current[1],current[2]]:E.triangleColor(x,y,current[0]);try{E.editColor(b,roleId,next.map(Math.round),!!b.groupMove);render(false);}catch(err){Object.assign(b,E.clone(drag.start));status(err.message,true);}}
$('wheel').onpointermove=moveWheel;for(const event of ['pointerup','pointercancel'])$('wheel').addEventListener(event,()=>{if(drag){drag=null;document.body.classList.remove('dragging');render(true);persist();}});
async function loadImage(file){try{const img=await createImageBitmap(file);reference=document.createElement('canvas');reference.width=img.width;reference.height=img.height;reference.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0);const canvas=$('reference'),scale=Math.min(1,1200/img.width);canvas.width=Math.round(img.width*scale);canvas.height=Math.round(img.height*scale);canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);img.close();canvas.hidden=false;$('reference-empty').hidden=true;status('Reference loaded. Click a color to sample it.');}catch(e){status('Could not load image: '+e.message,true);}}
$('load-image').onclick=()=>$('image-file').click();$('image-file').onchange=()=>{if($('image-file').files[0])loadImage($('image-file').files[0]);$('image-file').value='';};
document.addEventListener('paste',e=>{const item=[...(e.clipboardData?.items||[])].find(i=>i.type.startsWith('image/'));if(item){e.preventDefault();loadImage(item.getAsFile());}});
const referencePanel=document.querySelector('.reference');referencePanel.ondragover=e=>e.preventDefault();referencePanel.ondrop=e=>{e.preventDefault();const file=[...e.dataTransfer.files].find(f=>f.type.startsWith('image/'));if(file)loadImage(file);};
$('reference').onclick=e=>{if(!reference)return;const rect=$('reference').getBoundingClientRect(),x=E.clamp(Math.floor((e.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width*reference.width),0,reference.width-1),y=E.clamp(Math.floor((e.clientY-rect.top)/rect.height*reference.height),0,reference.height-1),data=reference.getContext('2d').getImageData(x,y,1,1).data;if(!data[3]){status('This pixel is fully transparent.');return;}addSample(E.rgbHsl([...data].slice(0,3)));};
$('export').onclick=()=>$('export-dialog').showModal();$('download-png').onclick=()=>{try{const scope=$('export-scope').value,kind=$('export-kind').value;let list=scope==='all'?project.balls:scope==='comparisons'?(project.comparisons||[.5,1,2,3]).map(t=>({...E.clone(ball()),strength:t,name:ball().name+' · '+t+'×'})):[ball()];if(scope==='samples'&&!samples.length)throw Error('Pick at least one screen or image color first.');if(scope==='samples')list=samples.map((s,i)=>({...E.clone(ball()),base:[...s],name:'Sample '+(i+1)}));const canvas=R.exportCanvas(list,kind,Number($('export-size').value),$('export-background').value,$('export-labels').checked,scope==='samples'&&kind==='strips'?samples:[]);canvas.toBlob(blob=>{if(!blob){status('PNG export failed. Try fewer balls or a smaller width.',true);return;}download(blob,safeName(scope==='all'?project.name:scope==='samples'?'Screen samples':ball().name)+'-'+kind+'.png');status('PNG exported');$('export-dialog').close();},'image/png');}catch(e){status(e.message,true);}};
render(true);
